---- MODULE ProxyGuard ----
\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.
\* The driver must read these outcomes from the real response, not compute them.
\* Each Init state is a prepared request; EvaluatePass/EvaluateRefuse call proxy.
\* Complete is a terminal stutter; no scheduling or eventual-call claim is made.
\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.
CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, Origins, AllowedHostLists, NoHeader
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result

vars == <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result>>

\* Isolated unratified preview F1/A.
\* Inputs distinguishing every other unanswered fork are omitted.

HostName(h) ==
    CASE h = NoHeader -> ""
      [] h = "localhost:3000" -> "localhost"
      [] h = "127.0.0.1:3000" -> "127.0.0.1"
      [] h = "[::1]:3000" -> "[::1]"
      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"
      [] h = "172.16.0.1:3000" -> "172.16.0.1"
      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"
      [] h = "172.15.0.1:3000" -> "172.15.0.1"
      [] h = "172.32.0.1:3000" -> "172.32.0.1"
      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] h = "127.999.0.1:3000" -> "127.999.0.1"
      [] h = "10.256.0.1:3000" -> "10.256.0.1"
      [] OTHER -> ""

LocalHost == HostName(host) \in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.2", "172.16.0.1", "172.31.0.1", "workstation.local", "127.999.0.1", "10.256.0.1"}

ListedHost ==
    CASE allowedHosts = "" -> FALSE
      [] allowedHosts = " , app.example , " -> (HostName(host) = "app.example")
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

TrustedHost == LocalHost \/ ListedHost

SafeMethod == method \in {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

Completed == result \in {"next", "403"}

ParsedOriginHost(o) ==
    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MalformedOrigin == origin \in {"not a URL", "null"}

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader
    \/ (~MalformedOrigin /\ MatchingOrigin)

PolicyPass == SafeMethod \/ (TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)

SafeMethodsPass == (Completed /\ SafeMethod) => result = "next"

HostBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost) => result = "403"

FetchSiteBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~FetchAccepted) => result = "403"

OriginBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~OriginAccepted) => result = "403"

CleanRequestsPass ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)
        => result = "next"

TypeOK ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

SafePassReachable ==
    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

CurlPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

AllowlistPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = " , app.example , "
    /\ result = "next"

BrowserPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ result = "403"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:4000"
    /\ result = "403"

BoundaryCase1 ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "127.999.0.1:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

BoundaryCase2 ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "10.256.0.1:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

Init ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result = "pending"

EvaluatePass ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

EvaluateRefuse ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Complete ==
    /\ Completed
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == EvaluatePass \/ EvaluateRefuse \/ Complete

\* Each mutation is independent and is deliberately excluded from Next.

    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugTrustSameSite ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site" /\ OriginAccepted

    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ ~OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockSafe ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockCurl ==

    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ LocalHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.
\* The driver must read these outcomes from the real response, not compute them.
\* Each Init state is a prepared request; EvaluatePass/EvaluateRefuse call proxy.
\* Complete is a terminal stutter; no scheduling or eventual-call claim is made.
\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.
CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, Origins, AllowedHostLists, NoHeader
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result

\* Isolated unratified preview F2/A.
\* Inputs distinguishing every other unanswered fork are omitted.

HostName(h) ==
    CASE h = NoHeader -> ""

      [] h = "127.0.0.1:3000" -> "127.0.0.1"
      [] h = "[::1]:3000" -> "[::1]"
      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"
      [] h = "172.16.0.1:3000" -> "172.16.0.1"
      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"
      [] h = "172.15.0.1:3000" -> "172.15.0.1"
      [] h = "172.32.0.1:3000" -> "172.32.0.1"
      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] h = "[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:3000" -> "[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]"
      [] h = "[fd00::1]:3000" -> "[fd00::1]"
      [] OTHER -> ""

LocalHost == HostName(host) \in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.2", "172.16.0.1", "172.31.0.1", "workstation.local"}

ListedHost ==
    CASE allowedHosts = "" -> FALSE
      [] allowedHosts = " , app.example , " -> (HostName(host) = "app.example")
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

TrustedHost == LocalHost \/ ListedHost

SafeMethod == method \in {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

Completed == result \in {"next", "403"}

ParsedOriginHost(o) ==
    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MalformedOrigin == origin \in {"not a URL", "null"}

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader
    \/ (~MalformedOrigin /\ MatchingOrigin)

PolicyPass == SafeMethod \/ (TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)

SafeMethodsPass == (Completed /\ SafeMethod) => result = "next"

HostBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost) => result = "403"

FetchSiteBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~FetchAccepted) => result = "403"

OriginBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~OriginAccepted) => result = "403"

CleanRequestsPass ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)
        => result = "next"

TypeOK ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

SafePassReachable ==
    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

CurlPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

AllowlistPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = " , app.example , "
    /\ result = "next"

BrowserPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ result = "403"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:4000"
    /\ result = "403"

BoundaryCase1 ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

BoundaryCase2 ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "[fd00::1]:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

Init ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result = "pending"

EvaluatePass ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

EvaluateRefuse ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Complete ==
    /\ Completed
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == EvaluatePass \/ EvaluateRefuse \/ Complete

\* Each mutation is independent and is deliberately excluded from Next.

    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugTrustSameSite ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site" /\ OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ ~OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockSafe ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockCurl ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ LocalHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.

\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.
CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, Origins, AllowedHostLists, NoHeader
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result

vars == <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result>>

\* Isolated unratified preview F3/B.
\* Inputs distinguishing every other unanswered fork are omitted.

HostName(h) ==
    CASE h = NoHeader -> ""
      [] h = "localhost:3000" -> "localhost"
      [] h = "127.0.0.1:3000" -> "127.0.0.1"
      [] h = "[::1]:3000" -> "[::1]"
      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"
      [] h = "172.16.0.1:3000" -> "172.16.0.1"
      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"
      [] h = "172.15.0.1:3000" -> "172.15.0.1"
      [] h = "172.32.0.1:3000" -> "172.32.0.1"
      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] h = "printer.lab.local:3000" -> "printer.lab.local"
      [] OTHER -> ""

LocalHost == HostName(host) \in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.2", "172.16.0.1", "172.31.0.1", "workstation.local", "printer.lab.local"}

ListedHost ==
    CASE allowedHosts = "" -> FALSE
      [] allowedHosts = " , app.example , " -> (HostName(host) = "app.example")
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

TrustedHost == LocalHost \/ ListedHost

SafeMethod == method \in {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

Completed == result \in {"next", "403"}

ParsedOriginHost(o) ==
    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader

OriginBoundary ==

CleanRequestsPass ==

        => result = "next"

    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

AllowlistPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = " , app.example , "
    /\ result = "next"

BrowserPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==

    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ result = "403"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:4000"
    /\ result = "403"

---- MODULE ProxyGuard ----
\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.
\* The driver must read these outcomes from the real response, not compute them.
\* Each Init state is a prepared request; EvaluatePass/EvaluateRefuse call proxy.
\* Complete is a terminal stutter; no scheduling or eventual-call claim is made.
\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.
CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, Origins, AllowedHostLists, NoHeader
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result

vars == <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result>>

\* Isolated unratified preview F4/B.
\* Inputs distinguishing every other unanswered fork are omitted.

HostName(h) ==
    CASE h = NoHeader -> ""
      [] h = "localhost:3000" -> "localhost"
      [] h = "127.0.0.1:3000" -> "127.0.0.1"
      [] h = "[::1]:3000" -> "[::1]"
      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"
      [] h = "172.16.0.1:3000" -> "172.16.0.1"
      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"
      [] h = "172.15.0.1:3000" -> "172.15.0.1"
      [] h = "172.32.0.1:3000" -> "172.32.0.1"
      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] OTHER -> ""

LocalHost == HostName(host) \in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.2", "172.16.0.1", "172.31.0.1", "workstation.local"}

ListedHost ==
    CASE allowedHosts = "" -> FALSE
      [] allowedHosts = " , app.example , " -> (HostName(host) = "app.example")
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

TrustedHost == LocalHost \/ ListedHost

SafeMethod == method \in {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

Completed == result \in {"next", "403"}

ParsedOriginHost(o) ==
    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MalformedOrigin == origin \in {"not a URL", "null", ""}

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader
    \/ (~MalformedOrigin /\ MatchingOrigin)

PolicyPass == SafeMethod \/ (TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)

SafeMethodsPass == (Completed /\ SafeMethod) => result = "next"

HostBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost) => result = "403"

FetchSiteBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~FetchAccepted) => result = "403"

OriginBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~OriginAccepted) => result = "403"

CleanRequestsPass ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)
        => result = "next"

TypeOK ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

SafePassReachable ==
    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

CurlPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

AllowlistPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = " , app.example , "
    /\ result = "next"

BrowserPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ result = "403"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:4000"
    /\ result = "403"

EmptyFetchCase ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ fetchSite = ""
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result = "403"

EmptyOriginCase ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = ""
    /\ result = "403"

Init ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result = "pending"

EvaluatePass ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

EvaluateRefuse ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Complete ==
    /\ Completed
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == EvaluatePass \/ EvaluateRefuse \/ Complete

\* Each mutation is independent and is deliberately excluded from Next.
BugBypassHost ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugTrustSameSite ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site" /\ OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugIgnoreOrigin ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ ~OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockSafe ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockCurl ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ LocalHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

---- MODULE ProxyGuard ----
\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.
\* The driver must read these outcomes from the real response, not compute them.
\* Each Init state is a prepared request; EvaluatePass/EvaluateRefuse call proxy.
\* Complete is a terminal stutter; no scheduling or eventual-call claim is made.
\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.

      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"

      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"

      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"

      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] h = "LOCALHOST:3000" -> "LOCALHOST"

      [] h = "localhost" -> "localhost"
      [] OTHER -> ""

      [] OTHER -> ""

      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"

      [] OTHER -> ""

---- MODULE ProxyGuard ----
\* Bounded observations of existing/proxy.ts; the source is never changed.
\* No accompanying test files were supplied in existing/.
\* A trace is one independent invocation: inputs are the NextRequest header
\* values and method, plus the exact ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS environment value.
\* NoHeader is an absent header, distinct from the empty string.
\* Build NextRequest with a fixed valid routing URL and set Host separately;
\* this also permits testing a missing Host and IPv4-looking invalid Host text.
\* "next" means NextResponse.next(); "403" means response.status = 403.
\* The driver must read these outcomes from the real response, not compute them.
\* Each Init state is a prepared request; EvaluatePass/EvaluateRefuse call proxy.
\* Complete is a terminal stutter; no scheduling or eventual-call claim is made.
\* Paths are requests already routed to proxy by /api/:path* or /statue/:path*;
\* route dispatch, response bodies and all other application state are outside scope.
\* POST represents the other-method branch; each safe method is checked separately.
\* Tables below expand parsing/classification for the exact bounded raw inputs.
\* Extend these tables when extending bounds; classifications are never driver inputs.
CONSTANTS Methods, Hosts, FetchSites, Origins, AllowedHostLists, NoHeader
VARIABLES method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result

vars == <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts, result>>

\* Isolated unratified preview F7/A.
\* Inputs distinguishing every other unanswered fork are omitted.

HostName(h) ==
    CASE h = NoHeader -> ""
      [] h = "localhost:3000" -> "localhost"
      [] h = "127.0.0.1:3000" -> "127.0.0.1"
      [] h = "[::1]:3000" -> "[::1]"
      [] h = "10.0.0.1:3000" -> "10.0.0.1"
      [] h = "192.168.1.2:3000" -> "192.168.1.2"
      [] h = "172.16.0.1:3000" -> "172.16.0.1"
      [] h = "172.31.0.1:3000" -> "172.31.0.1"
      [] h = "172.15.0.1:3000" -> "172.15.0.1"
      [] h = "172.32.0.1:3000" -> "172.32.0.1"
      [] h = "workstation.local:3000" -> "workstation.local"
      [] h = "app.example:3000" -> "app.example"
      [] h = "evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example"
      [] h = "app.example:4000" -> "app.example"
      [] OTHER -> ""

LocalHost == HostName(host) \in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]", "10.0.0.1", "192.168.1.2", "172.16.0.1", "172.31.0.1", "workstation.local"}

ListedHost ==
    CASE allowedHosts = "" -> FALSE
      [] allowedHosts = " , app.example , " -> (HostName(host) = "app.example")
      [] allowedHosts = "app.example:3000" -> (HostName(host) = "app.example:3000")
      [] OTHER -> FALSE

TrustedHost == LocalHost \/ ListedHost

SafeMethod == method \in {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}

Completed == result \in {"next", "403"}

ParsedOriginHost(o) ==
    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MalformedOrigin == origin \in {"not a URL", "null"}

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader
    \/ (~MalformedOrigin /\ MatchingOrigin)

PolicyPass == SafeMethod \/ (TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)

SafeMethodsPass == (Completed /\ SafeMethod) => result = "next"

HostBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost) => result = "403"

FetchSiteBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~FetchAccepted) => result = "403"

OriginBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~OriginAccepted) => result = "403"

CleanRequestsPass ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)
        => result = "next"

TypeOK ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

SafePassReachable ==
    /\ method = "GET"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "cross-site"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

CurlPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "next"

AllowlistPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = " , app.example , "
    /\ result = "next"

BrowserPassReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "evil.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "not a URL"
    /\ result = "403"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "localhost:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:4000"
    /\ result = "403"

AllowlistPortExample ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:3000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = "app.example:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

OtherPortRefusal ==
    /\ method = "POST"
    /\ host = "app.example:4000"
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader
    /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ allowedHosts = "app.example:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

Init ==
    /\ method \in Methods
    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result = "pending"

EvaluatePass ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

EvaluateRefuse ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Complete ==
    /\ Completed
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == EvaluatePass \/ EvaluateRefuse \/ Complete

\* Each mutation is independent and is deliberately excluded from Next.
BugBypassHost ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugTrustSameSite ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost
    /\ fetchSite = "same-site" /\ OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugIgnoreOrigin ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ ~OriginAccepted
    /\ result' = "next"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockSafe ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

BugBlockCurl ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ ~SafeMethod /\ LocalHost
    /\ fetchSite = NoHeader /\ origin = NoHeader
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

    CASE o = "http://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "https://localhost:3000" -> "localhost:3000"
      [] o = "http://localhost:4000" -> "localhost:4000"
      [] o = "http://evil.example:3000" -> "evil.example:3000"
      [] OTHER -> ""

MalformedOrigin == origin \in {"not a URL", "null"}

MatchingOrigin == ParsedOriginHost(origin) = host

FetchAccepted == fetchSite \in {NoHeader, "same-origin", "none"}

OriginAccepted ==
    \/ origin = NoHeader
    \/ (~MalformedOrigin /\ MatchingOrigin)

PolicyPass == SafeMethod \/ (TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)

SafeMethodsPass == (Completed /\ SafeMethod) => result = "next"

HostBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~TrustedHost) => result = "403"

FetchSiteBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~FetchAccepted) => result = "403"

OriginBoundary ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ ~OriginAccepted) => result = "403"

CleanRequestsPass ==
    (Completed /\ ~SafeMethod /\ TrustedHost /\ FetchAccepted /\ OriginAccepted)
        => result = "next"

TypeOK ==

    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result \in {"pending", "next", "403"}

SafePassReachable ==

BrowserPassReachable ==

    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "next"

HostRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"

    /\ allowedHosts = ""
    /\ result = "403"

FetchRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"

    /\ fetchSite = "same-site"
    /\ origin = "http://localhost:3000"
    /\ result = "403"

MalformedRefusalReachable ==
    /\ method = "POST"

    /\ fetchSite = "same-origin"

MismatchRefusalReachable ==

Init ==

    /\ host \in Hosts
    /\ fetchSite \in FetchSites
    /\ origin \in Origins
    /\ allowedHosts \in AllowedHostLists
    /\ result = "pending"

EvaluatePass ==
    /\ result = "pending"
    /\ PolicyPass

EvaluateRefuse ==

    /\ ~PolicyPass
    /\ result' = "403"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<method, host, fetchSite, origin, allowedHosts>>

Complete ==

Next == EvaluatePass \/ EvaluateRefuse \/ Complete

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: Each trace starts with one bounded request, follows the guard decision rules, and leaves completed observations unchanged.

pins.name: SafeMethodsPass
pins.says: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS always pass, regardless of the host or browser headers.

pins.name: HostBoundary
pins.says: Every other method is refused with 403 unless its Host is local or matches the configured allowlist under this candidate policy.

pins.name: FetchSiteBoundary
pins.says: Within these bounds, every other method is refused with 403 unless Sec-Fetch-Site is absent, same-origin or none.

pins.name: OriginBoundary
pins.says: Within these bounds, every other method is refused with 403 if a supplied Origin is not a URL or its host and port differ from Host.

pins.name: CleanRequestsPass
pins.says: A request with an unsafe method passes when its host is trusted and both browser headers are acceptable under this candidate policy.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every request field and allowlist setting stays within its bounded input set, and the result is pending, passed on, or refused with 403.

pins.name: SafePassReachable
pins.says: A GET with an untrusted host and hostile browser headers can pass.

pins.name: CurlPassReachable
pins.says: A POST to localhost with neither browser header can pass.

pins.name: AllowlistPassReachable
pins.says: A POST to an allowlisted nonlocal hostname with neither browser header can pass.

pins.name: BrowserPassReachable
pins.says: A POST to localhost with same-origin metadata and a matching Origin can pass.

pins.name: HostRefusalReachable
pins.says: A POST to an untrusted host with neither browser header can be refused with 403.

pins.name: FetchRefusalReachable
pins.says: A POST to localhost marked same-site can be refused with 403 even when Origin matches.

pins.name: MalformedRefusalReachable
pins.says: A POST to localhost with a malformed Origin can be refused with 403.

pins.name: MismatchRefusalReachable
pins.says: A POST to localhost with an Origin naming a different port can be refused with 403.

pins.name: AllowlistPortExample
pins.says: A header-free POST to app.example:3000 with app.example:3000 allowlisted can pass.

pins.name: OtherPortRefusal
pins.says: A header-free POST to app.example:4000 with only app.example:3000 allowlisted can be refused with 403.

pins.name: BugBypassHost
pins.says: A faulty guard passes an unsafe request to an untrusted host when browser headers are absent.

pins.name: BugTrustSameSite
pins.says: A faulty guard treats same-site as acceptable for an unsafe request with a trusted host and matching Origin.

pins.name: BugIgnoreOrigin
pins.says: A faulty guard passes an unsafe request with a trusted host and acceptable fetch metadata despite a malformed or mismatching Origin.

pins.name: BugBlockSafe
pins.says: A faulty guard applies the host restriction to a safe method and refuses it with 403.

pins.name: BugBlockCurl
pins.says: A faulty guard refuses an unsafe request to a trusted local host just because both browser headers are absent.
